verdict.rationale: Omarchy's manual states that "Everything in Omarchy happens via the keyboard — EVERYTHING!" It documents an application launcher (Super + Space), the Omarchy Menu (Super + Alt + Space), a keybinding overview (Super + K), window tiling and layout toggles, and dedicated hotkeys for the terminal, browser, clipboard, reminders, OCR and dictation. Community users praise the tiling workflow but do not specifically confirm keyboard-only operation. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that the whole system is operable keyboard-only (docs themselves hedge with clipboard hotkeys working "(almost) everywhere" and a click-the-notification crash flow).
